scope.construction: Two labelled copies; retain any two base marks per side; delete any vertex not incident with a retained mark; glue the two three-edge boundaries by all six bijections.

interpretation: No tested three-sum has four required marks which are universally separated, nonpacking, and satisfy the exact marked cyclic-cut condition. The search_record_calls value is an implementation trace, not a census of all Tait colourings, because a row stops when the required marks first conflict.

direct_proof.statement: For each of the three retained mark pairs, three displayed base circuits have vertex-set intersection exactly the four mark endpoints. Hence every allowed vertex deletion leaves a circuit through both marks, giving a closed admissible state on each shore; all 13,824 three-sums therefore pack.

limitations: The labelled output is not quotient by isomorphism.
This is a structured family, not a complete graph census.
Zero finite witnesses is not a universal three-edge-cut theorem.
The generator and checker are AI-assisted and not independent human review.
